# The public keys the games' archive headers are locked with.
#
# Each .bhd header is RSA-encrypted: 256 bytes in, 255 out, plain modular
# exponentiation with the public key. There is no label saying which key
# belongs to which archive and none is needed — the right one is the one
# whose first block comes out starting BHD5, and a wrong one cannot fake it.
#
# One key per line: the modulus in hex, then the exponent.
